defender.note: Generic role. 'zagueiro' only for a centre back, which the app never names.

outfield player.note: Roster label 'Outfield {n}' = 'Jogador de linha {n}' or 'Linha {n}' where space is short.

side.note: Left side / right side of a match. 'Your side' = 'Seu lado'.

home and away.note: For a league: 'turno e returno'. For a tie: 'ida e volta'. Avoid 'em casa e fora'.

role (GK, DF, MF, FW).note: Short labels GOL, DEF, MEI, ATA. In control settings 'GRF role' = 'função no GRF'.

socks.note: Football socks are 'meião' in Brazil. pt-BR.json says 'Meias' today.

trim.note: 'Trim color' = 'Cor dos detalhes'. pt-BR.json uses singular 'detalhe', which reads oddly.

shirt number.note: In captions 'number {number}' = 'camisa {number}' is good and stays.

halves.note: pt-BR.json says 'Metades'. 'Camisa meio a meio' is what fans say.

match.note: A match between two sides. Short labels may use 'jogo'.

kick-off (restart after a goal).note: format.mode.kickoff and transition.restart.kickoff are restarts. Use 'Saída de bola' there.

shots (statistic).note: Stat columns and charts. 'Shots and goals' = 'Finalizações e gols'.

on target.note: 'Shots on target' = 'finalizações no gol'. Column 'On target' = 'No gol'.

tackle (statistic, event).note: pt-BR.json uses 'carrinho' for every tackle. Stats, moments filter, sound 'when a player wins the ball' and awards count desarmes.

sprint.note: Button 'Correr'. Engine action 'release sprint' = 'parar de correr'.

release direction / sprint / dribble.pt: soltar direção / parar de correr / parar de driblar
release direction / sprint / dribble.note: GRF sticky actions. 'Soltar corrida' reads as a literal calque.

referee calls / decisions.note: 'Decision replays' = 'Replays dos lances de arbitragem'. 'Replays de decisões' is a calque.

restart.note: The restart of play after a stoppage. 'Restart transitions' = 'Transições nos reinícios'. For the playback control 'Restart' see 'restart (playback)'.

free kick.note: In captions 'Falta para {team}' also reads naturally, but keep 'tiro livre' in labels and filters.

penalty spot.note: Achievement 'From the spot' = 'Da marca da cal' is good.

pitch.note: 'campo' also fine, but 'Campo' is the page name, so prefer 'gramado' for the playing surface.

boards.note: Advertising boards. 'placas de publicidade' where context needs it.

goals for.note: Table column 'For' = 'GP' or 'Pró'. In prose 'gols marcados'.

clean sheet.note: As Cartola says it (SG). Column short form 'SG'.

brace.note: pt-BR.json says 'Doblete', which is Spanish. Narrators say 'fez o bis'.

late winner.note: Or 'gol no apagar das luzes' in the award name.

MVP.note: 'MVP medal' = 'Medalha de craque da partida'. 'Most valuable player' = 'Craque da partida' too.

playmaker (most assists).note: Brazilian slang for the assist king. 'Creator' (key passes) = 'Armador'.

move (celebration).note: The list of celebration moves. Use 'movimento' only where 'comemoração' would repeat badly.

post-match show.note: Noun. 'Show at full time' = 'Pós-jogo'. Avoid 'show pós-jogo'.

classic league.note: Preset 'Classic league' = 'Pontos corridos', the Brazilian name of the double round robin.

king of the hill.note: The pickup-football rule Brazilians know, and exactly this format. 'Rei da colina' is a calque. 'king {name}' in round labels = 'no comando: {name}'.

round of N.note: Count is a placeholder, so 'oitavas' cannot be used. Keep 'fase de {count}'.

seed (bracket position).note: 'top seeds' = 'melhores cabeças de chave', 'lowest seeds' = 'piores cabeças de chave'.

seeding.note: pt-BR.json says 'distribuição', which hides the meaning.

enter (a tournament).note: '{count} entrants so far' = '{count} inscritos até agora'.

leg.note: 'Two legged ties' = 'confrontos de ida e volta'. '{match}, leg {number}' = '{match}, jogo {number}'.

replay (extra tournament match).note: pt-BR.json says 'nova partida'. Not to be confused with the broadcast replay.

rating (entrant, Elo-like).note: As Brazilian chess and games say it. Distinct from the player 'nota'.

format (team, 5v5 or 11v11).note: '5 against 5' = '5 contra 5'. 'five a side' = 'cinco contra cinco'. 'Eleven a side' = 'onze contra onze'.

vs / against (two teams).note: '{left} against {right}' = '{left} x {right}' everywhere. pt-BR.json mixes 'contra' and 'x'. Use 'contra' only in prose such as 'jogar contra a IA'.

Recorder.note: The Python class cuju.render.Recorder stays in English in backticks. As a source label 'Recorder' = 'Gravador (script)'.

Trash.note: Capitalized as a place, as Windows pt-BR does.

delete permanently.note: Button may stay 'Excluir permanentemente'. Confirmation prose reads better with 'para sempre'.

tags.note: What Brazilian apps say. pt-BR.json says 'etiquetas'.

provenance.note: pt-BR.json says 'procedência', which sounds like a legal document.

source (of a recording).note: Filter 'Source' on Recordings and Moments = 'Origem'. Different from 'live source'.

live source.note: The running script that streams. Keep distinct from the stream itself.

go live.note: pt-BR.json says 'Ir para o ao vivo'.

request (a match).note: Noun 'solicitação'. server.feed strings use 'pedida', align them.

built-in AI.note: GRF's own bot. 'IA embutida' (47 uses today) sounds like hardware. 'GRF's built-in AI' = 'IA nativa do GRF'. Also a team name in lists.

registered team.note: pt-BR.json says 'registrado'. 'Cadastrar' is what Brazilian apps say.

episode.note: 'End of episode' = 'Fim do episódio'. pt-BR.json says 'Partida encerrada', which is wrong for academy episodes that end early.

step (engine).note: 'steps' of a match. Different from tour and wizard steps.

academy (GRF scenario family).note: 'Academia' means gym in Brazil. 'Academy, corner' = 'Treino: escanteio'. Achievement 'Academy graduate' = 'Cria da base'. Keep code names academy_* untouched.

run (of a challenge).note: pt-BR.json says 'rodada', which collides with tournament rounds, and 'execução' in server messages. 'Full run' = 'Sessão completa'.

run headless.note: Plays on the server without the page, faster than real time. pt-BR.json says 'Rodar em segundo plano'. 'headless run' = 'simulação'.

leaderboard.note: Challenge boards. Keeps 'classificação' free for tournament standings.

off the mark (achievement).note: First goal. pt-BR.json says 'Saiu do zero'.

giant slayer (achievement).note: Beating the strongest AI. pt-BR.json says 'Matador de gigantes'.

clean feed.note: Brazilian TV term for the feed without overlays. Here it keeps the broadcast graphics, so 'sinal' alone is fine after first mention.

replay (broadcast).note: Noun. Verb 'Replay the last goal' = 'Rever o último gol'.

moment (searchable event).note: The Moments feature. 'Search moments' = 'Buscar lances'. 'Moments of this match' = 'Lances desta partida'.

moment (point in time).note: 'Go to the newest moment' = 'Ir para o momento mais recente'.

field editor.note: The app calls it the Field page. Say 'na página Campo'.

home folder (renderer's folder).note: The folder chosen by --home. pt-BR.json says 'pasta base'.

custom.note: Agree with the noun: 'Personalizada' for predefinição.

motion (reduced motion).note: 'Reduced motion' = 'Animações reduzidas'. 'Movimento' reads as player movement.

View menu.note: pt-BR software names this menu 'Exibir'. pt-BR.json says 'Visualização'.

bumper.note: Brazilian players say RB and LB. 'Right bumper' = 'Bumper direito (RB)' where room allows.

tester (input).note: 'Input tester' = 'Teste de controles'. 'Testador' sounds like a job title.

drop (a file).note: 'Drop a .cjr file here' = 'Arraste um arquivo .cjr para cá'.

choose / pick / select.note: 'selecionar' for items in a list or canvas.

reset (to defaults).note: 'Reset' alone on a control = 'Redefinir'. Reset the roll or zoom = 'zerar'.

next.note: Agree with the noun: 'Próxima' for etapa, lição, tentativa. Wizard button = 'Avançar'.

start.note: 'iniciar' for processes and the server. 'Start challenge' = 'Iniciar desafio'.

seek.note: 'A click on the timeline seeks' = 'Clique na linha do tempo para ir a outro ponto'. pt-BR.json says 'muda o ponto da partida'.

could not / failed to.note: 'X could not be read, {reason}' = 'Não foi possível ler X: {reason}'.

seconds / minutes.note: Short labels '12 s', '3 min'. Prose may spell 'segundos', 'minutos'.

page names.pt: Início, Assistir, Jogar, Gravações, Partidas, Torneios, Times, Campo, Ajuda
page names.note: Home, Watch, Play, Recordings, Matches, Tournaments, Teams, Field, Help. Cited in prose without quotes: 'na página Partidas'.

preset.note: Presentation, field and tournament presets alike. 'Custom' preset = 'Personalizada'.

camera.note: Broadcast = 'transmissão', tactical = 'tática', behind the goal = 'atrás do gol', free = 'livre', follow player = 'seguir jogador'.
